rows.concrete_observation: finalizeSpawn sets four shields and 60 shared shield HP. Native hurt with a shield except OUT_OF_WORLD/DROWN subtracts the entire amount, updates last attacker, breaks at most one shield at thresholds or plays hurt sound, then returns false. Thus false can consume defense without HP loss. baseTick separately breaks one remaining shield each tick when shared HP<=0. Each break resets 150-tick regeneration; regeneration restores one shield and 15 shared HP, not full health. Negative shared HP may immediately break a regenerated shield. Synced shield count drives four model bones in one consumer. NBT saves count/HP but not regeneration timer.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: Separate refused health damage, consumed defensive resource, and final control admission. A feedback reason must follow the actual branch; false alone cannot label absolute immunity. Review shield recovery across save/load rather than infer it from persisted shield count.
rows.semantic_dedup: Compared master tf-lich-shield-and-clone-rejection (magic hit removes a layer), tf-mounted-goblin-shared-shield-rejection (shared mounted shield with disable counter), and tf-snowqueen-multipart-shield-native-refusal-sound. Candidate distinction is shared numerical HP overflow, single break per hurt plus subsequent tick cascade and staged resource rearm. All four shields, sounds, sync, model and NBT are ONE proposal; Russell may merge if same semantic family.
rows.limitations: Static only. Renderer constructor binds model but no WildfireRenderer registration was found in fixed cached source; no claim of visible registered rendering. No server-only guard in the shown shield resource branch/baseTick, so do not infer authority exclusivity. Defaults before finalizeSpawn are zero. Timer-loss consequence is conditional static observation, not reproduced save/load bug.

rows.concrete_observation: Inactive native hurt except OUT_OF_WORLD always plays iron-door impact and returns false. This branch sets target only when the causing LivingEntity itself isInvulnerable; ordinary attackers do not satisfy that condition. Server tick reactivates from a nonnull target OR an active raid; after >200 targetless ticks active form returns dormant. Registered Activate/Deactivate goals broadcast negative attack IDs and distinct open/off sounds; client event resets attack timer. This is damage refusal state, not the existing stomp knockback-cancellation chain.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: Keep phase state, explicit refusal cue, and wake-up policy distinct. Do not translate every rejected hit into a target change, and do not claim a quiet inactive phase stays inactive while raid policy can activate it.
rows.semantic_dedup: Master same source full-file read already supports the separate stomp control path. No credit for reading that file again or for activation animations. Proposed difference is inactive damage gate plus independently authored wake policy/cue; if phase-refusal family already covers it, downgrade this entire row to support0.
rows.limitations: Static source proposal, not native AI run. The unusual attacker.isInvulnerable condition is recorded literally, not corrected or recommended. Target selector can independently acquire targets; no assertion that ordinary attacks can never wake it. No dedicated immune text or per-target rate limiter.
